title: Event Time-series Interchange File
description: Interchange format for dog sport events. Scheduling and check-in applications provide a chronological log of who is at each location so event photographers can map photos to participants and infuse images with event and team metadata. The format assumes one participant at a location at a time and timestamps accurate to within a couple of seconds.

schema_version.description: Document format version. 2.1.0 adds optional per-camera time calibration offset on photographer check-ins.

entries.description: Chronological log of timeseries records sorted by each entry's at timestamp. An empty array is valid for a newly created file. When setup records are present for a location, photographer_check_in and set_discipline entries should appear before the first team_check_in at that location.

event.title: Event metadata
event.description: Metadata describing the trial or competition. Only name is required; additional fields help photographers categorize photos by organization, venue, location, and date.

dogsportphoto_code.description: Optional namespaced application field (<application>_<field>). Four-digit DogSportPhoto event code used by the teams app and in on-disk filenames when present. Applications that do not use this field should ignore it.

org.description: Optional organization or sanctioning body, such as DockDogs, Updog, or AKC.

start_date.description: Optional inclusive event start date in YYYY-MM-DD form.

end_date.description: Optional inclusive event end date in YYYY-MM-DD form.

city.description: Optional city where the event is held.

state.description: Optional state, province, or region for the event location.

org_type.description: Optional organization type or sport family, such as dock, disc, or agility.

entryTimestamp.description: ISO 8601 date-time when the entry was recorded, including timezone offset. Accuracy should be within a couple of seconds and synced to a canonical time source so photos can be matched to the participant who was on the field.

locationName.description: Location, ring, pool, dock, lane, or arena name. Use virtual locations such as Dock 1 - Lane 1 and Dock 1 - Lane 2 when more than one participant may be active in the same physical area at once. Use default when no named location applies.

handler.title: Handler
handler.description: Handler identity for a team check-in. Email is strongly recommended because it is the primary mechanism photographers use to connect participants with their photos.

dogsportphoto_code.description: Optional namespaced application field. Registered handler entity code when known.

email.description: Optional handler email. Strongly recommended and should be repeated on every check-in for the same participant when available.

dog.title: Dog
dog.description: Dog identity for a team check-in. Optional on the entry, but highly desirable. Omitted in some QR-based or proxy check-in flows where the specific dog cannot be tracked.

dogsportphoto_code.description: Optional namespaced application field. Registered dog entity code when known.

breed.description: Optional dog breed. Helps photographers identify dogs in images.

color.description: Optional dog color. Helps photographers identify dogs in images.

org_ids.description: Optional map of organization slug to registration or entry number, such as akc or ddww. Used for cross-event tracking and may be written to photo metadata as X-id-<org> keywords.

team.title: Team
team.description: Formatted handler-and-dog label used for photo keywording.

name.description: Team display label, commonly in the form Handler n Dog.

dogsportphoto_code.description: Optional namespaced application field. Registered team entity code when known.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.description: Optional attendance metadata attached to a team check-in under the event property.

photo_request.description: Whether the handler requested event photos.

message_to_photographer.description: Optional one-line note from the handler to the photographer.

camera.title: Camera
camera.description: Camera registered by a photographer at a location.

serial.description: Camera serial number. Used to correlate images to a photographer location check-in.

offset.description: Optional time calibration offset in seconds added to this camera's EXIF capture time when matching photos to check-ins (same sign as DogSportPhoto camera calibration).

photographer.title: Photographer
photographer.description: Photographer identity and cameras checked in at a location.

cameras.description: Cameras the photographer is using at this location.

teamCheckInEntry.title: Team check-in
teamCheckInEntry.description: Records a handler check-in, optionally with dog, team, and attendance details. Represents the participant who was on the field at the location at the recorded time.

type.description: Entry type discriminator for a participant check-in.

photographerCheckInEntry.title: Photographer check-in
photographerCheckInEntry.description: Records a photographer and their cameras at a location. Normally written by photographer-centric applications such as the DogSportPhoto teams app before team check-ins begin. Scheduling applications that do not integrate photographers typically omit this entry type. Used to tie images to a location by correlating camera serial numbers with the photographer's checked-in location.

type.description: Entry type discriminator for photographer setup at a location.

setDisciplineEntry.title: Set discipline
setDisciplineEntry.description: Records the active discipline or activity at a location. Should be written before team check-ins at that location when discipline metadata is used. The discipline value is user-defined; examples include Big Air, Speed Retrieve, Boom!, Jumpers or Standard. Consumers should treat the latest set_discipline entry at a location as the current discipline.

type.description: Entry type discriminator for discipline or activity selection.

discipline.description: Discipline, game, class, or activity name for the location at this time, such as Distance Jump, Big Air, Boom!, or Jumpers.

timeseriesEntry.title: Timeseries entry
timeseriesEntry.description: One chronological record in the entries log. Valid types are team_check_in, photographer_check_in, and set_discipline.
